Tooltip: Semantic free-text search over the whole store. Embeds the query, scores every chunk by cosine similarity, returns the top-K rows. Multilingual: Arabic queries match English data and vice versa.

Arguments.Name: in_Query
Arguments.Tooltip: Natural-language search text. The whole stored row/chunk is matched semantically, so phrases work better than single keywords.
Arguments.Placeholder: e.g. أفضل جامعة في أمريكا للتكنولوجيا

Arguments.Name: in_SharePath
Arguments.Tooltip: Full path of the canonical store.db (usually on a network share). Never opened directly - a local copy is synced first, only when the share is newer.

Arguments.Name: in_LocalDbPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Where this machine keeps its local read copy of the store, e.g. C:\rag\read\store.db. Created automatically.

Arguments.Name: in_EmbeddingUrl
Arguments.Tooltip: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (POST .../v1/embeddings). The query is embedded with the same model used at ingest.

Arguments.Name: in_ApiKey
Arguments.Tooltip: Bearer token for the embedding endpoint. Leave empty for anonymous endpoints. Source from an Orchestrator Credential asset - never hardcode.

Arguments.Name: in_Model
Arguments.Tooltip: Model name sent to the endpoint. MUST match the model the store was ingested with (stored in the meta table, e.g. BAAI/bge-m3) or scores are meaningless.

Arguments.Name: in_TopK
Arguments.Tooltip: How many best-matching rows to return. Typical: 5.

Arguments.Name: in_TimeoutSec
Arguments.Tooltip: HTTP timeout per embedding call. Allow extra headroom for cold model starts (e.g. 120).

Arguments.Name: in_MaxRetries
Arguments.Tooltip: Retries for transient embedding failures (5xx, timeouts, 429). Permanent 4xx errors fail immediately without retrying.

Arguments.Name: out_dt_Results
Arguments.Tooltip: DataTable ranked best-first. Columns: Rank (Int32), DocId (String), ChunkIndex (Int32), Content (the full stored row JSON / chunk text), Score (Double, cosine similarity).
